meta.description: Filter alignments by flags, mapping quality, and regions using samtools view and pysam. Use when extracting specific reads, removing low-quality alignments, or subsetting to target regions.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: Live checks reproduced the documented MAPQ, FLAG, expression, region, and duplicate-marking behavior; no fabricated research result or identifier was found.

practice_boundaries.detail: The Skill filters alignment files and does not diagnose, prescribe, or triage individuals.

methodological_ground.detail: MAPQ guidance is aligner-specific; duplicate, SV, pair-orphan, signed-template-length, and zero-width BED limits are disclosed.

code_usability.detail: All shipped Python scripts parsed, the shell script passed bash -n, and current-source executions produced asserted BAM outputs.

functional_suitability.note: Covers flags, MAPQ, regions, BED, read groups, expressions, deterministic subsampling, and assay-aware hand-offs with runnable scripts.

reliability.note: Scripts and documentation handle major traps and preserve inputs; malformed BED rows can still surface low-level parsing errors.

performance_context.note: The concise SKILL.md routes specialized material to three references and reusable scripts.

agent_usability.note: Clear commands, checked caveats, count/validation guidance, and a compact reference index; names vary slightly between examples.

human_usability.note: Natural trigger examples and an overview are present; the description could name downsampling and read-group filtering.

security.note: No credentials, eval/exec, destructive cleanup, or source-data overwrite; command-line file paths are necessarily caller supplied.

maintainability.note: Responsibilities are separated into scripts and references, source paths are documented, and each script is small and testable.

agent_specific.note: Precise triggering, progressive disclosure, related-skill hand-offs, deterministic seed guidance, and explicit caller/format limits are strong.

key_strengths: All substantive prior input classes were replayed against the exact dispatched tip, with all 49 scored representative assertions passing; retained logs contain additional low-level checks.

Scripts are separated from the concise SKILL.md, shipped, syntax-checked, and run on real BAMs plus labeled synthetic truth fixtures.

recommendations.title: Make zero-width BED handling explicit at script runtime
recommendations.problem: filter_by_bed.py silently returns no reads for a zero-width row while samtools -L returned 539 on this fixture. The reference accurately discloses the difference, but a direct script user gets no warning.
recommendations.root_cause: The script delegates zero-width intervals to fetch(start, end), whose empty half-open range cannot express samtools behavior.
recommendations.fix: Reject start >= end with a concise error, or emit a warning identifying rows that must be dropped or widened before continuing.
